**Record fibers (A1c-Q1′ bounded study, v0.3.25; new science, separately reviewed; Q1′ itself stays OPEN).**

`[ALG]` [RID: RECOG-ALG-A1C-THRESHOLD-CODING] [scope: $x_0\in U$; F2(b) conventions] [proof: immediate from Lemmas A and B of the A1b cell; `records/recog/RECOG_A1C_Q1PRIME_FIBER_SESSION_v0_1.md` v0.2 (Prop. 6)] With the overshoot $o_j=\hat\varphi_{n_j}-2\pi\ell_j\in[0,\tfrac\pi2)$ and the six-step deficit $\Delta_j=2\pi-\Lambda_6(x_{n_j})$ at the $j$-th anchor, the record is the threshold coding $g_{j+1}=7\iff o_j<\Delta_j$ of the sawtooth $o_{j+1}=o_j-\Delta_j$ (gap $6$), $o_{j+1}=o_j-\Delta_j+\delta_T(x_{n_j+6})$ (gap $7$); two starts have the same record iff $n_0=n_0'$ and $[o_j<\Delta_j]=[o'_j<\Delta'_j]$ for every $j$. Depends on: RECOG-THM-A1B-SLIP-SCHEDULE-U.

`[ALG]` [RID: RECOG-ALG-A1C-PHASE-C1-FIBER] [scope: chart row A, $0<q_0\le q^*=\tfrac{256}{140625}$ (every start in $U$); conditional on DYAD-THM-NF-REM ($C_7$, $C_D$), DYAD-THM-NF-INV, DYAD-ALG-NF6 only — no R9 row and no (D5) constant] [proof: cell v0.2 §2 (Prop. 7, Cor. 8, Prop. 9); certificate RECOG-ART-A1C-Q1PRIME-FIBER] (i) $\Psi_\infty=\lim_m(\Theta_m-\tau\log q_m)$ is $C^1$ in $(\lambda_0,\Theta_0)=(\log q_0,\Theta_0)$ on the punctured row disk, with $|\partial_{\Theta_0}\Psi_\infty-1|\le c_\Psi q_0$, $c_\Psi=11.13$ (so $\le0.0203$ on the row), and $\partial_{\lambda_0}\Psi_\infty=-\tau+O(q_0)$: $\Psi_\infty=\Psi(z_0)+\sum_m\sigma(z_m)$ with $\sigma=\operatorname{Im}[(1-2i\tau)\operatorname{Log}(1+u)]$, where $(1-2i\tau)\mu=-\tfrac{19}6$ is real (the normal-form coefficient is exactly the log-spiral direction), so $\sigma=O(q^2)$ with explicit derivative ceilings, the polar Jacobian of $\widehat F$ is $\begin{pmatrix}1-q&0\\-\tau q&1\end{pmatrix}+O(q^2)$ and the derivative series converges uniformly (Grönwall constant $\Xi=0.027$). (ii) Every level set $\{\Psi_\infty\equiv\psi\pmod{2\pi}\}$ in the row is one $C^1$ graph curve $\Theta_0=\theta_\psi(q_0)$ (one point per circle $q_0={\rm const}$); since the record determines $L=\tfrac\pi3n_0-2\pi\ell_0+\Psi_{W,\infty}$ (RECOG-RESULT-A1C-RECORD-PHASE-READOUT) and $\Psi_{z,\infty}=\Psi_{W,\infty}$, the record fiber $\mathcal R^{-1}(\mathcal R(x_0))\cap U$ is contained in the single curve $\mathcal C_\psi$, $\psi=L-\tfrac\pi3n_0$, parametrized injectively by $q_0$ — in particular it has empty interior. The fiber is a subset of the curve, not necessarily a segment: a disconnected fiber is not excluded. (iii) On $\mathcal C_\psi$ record equality is equality of the threshold codings of RECOG-ALG-A1C-THRESHOLD-CODING (exact reduction of Q1′ to a one-dimensional coding question). Depends on: RECOG-RESULT-A1C-RECORD-PHASE-READOUT; RECOG-THM-A1A-PHASE-EXISTENCE-ALT; the three Dyadic rows named in the scope.
**Not supplied:** injectivity or non-injectivity of the record map (A1c-Q1′, OPEN R6); connectedness of fibers; the cell's slip-margin criterion (partners flip at the first return whose normalized margin ${\rm crit}_j=|o_j-\Delta_j|(a+M_j)/\tau$ is exceeded; sign-dependent) is `[SESSION/HEUR]` in the cell and is not registered here — its `[NUM]` level-curve pairs (six partners of a base orbit; first differing return as predicted in 6/6) illustrate a mechanism and do not bear on the infinite record; any event or write statement (SG-R6).
